destination.title: Higgs-sector phenomenology and model tests
destination.question: Which measurements, parameter fits and predicted signals constrain specified Higgs-sector extensions or reveal heavy interactions?
destination.summary: A home for effective interactions, model viability and experimental inference, including applications of naturalness proposals.

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: Which heavy-threshold interactions dominate Higgs observables when the new sector is approximately supersymmetric? The answer depends jointly on the heavy-scale ratios and η = cot β.

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: What is the constrained scalar-Higgs baseline against which new interactions are compared? Once v is fixed, the tree-level MSSM spectrum depends on mA and tan β.

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: Can discrepancies between measured Higgs masses and MSSM predictions, after determining the stop sector, reveal heavy additional degrees of freedom? Correlated Higgs and electroweakino observables provide further tests of the proposed effective interactions.

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: Can a broken additional gauge interaction provide Higgs quartic corrections while its vector multiplet is integrated out?

sources.title: Global Fits of the Large Volume String Scenario to WMAP5 and Other Indirect Constraints Using Markov Chain Monte Carlo

evidence.text: Can the minimal Large Volume Scenario fit the paper's cosmological, electroweak, flavour and direct-search constraints, and how do the preferred parameters depend on priors and the sign of μ?

sources.title: Randall-Sundrum and Strings

evidence.text: Can phenomenologically viable string completions of Randall–Sundrum electroweak compositeness place string resonances parametrically above KK resonances, once Standard Model perturbativity and confinement-transition cosmology constrain the strong sector?

sources.title: Non-thermal CMSSM with a 125 GeV Higgs

evidence.text: Which nonthermal CMSSM/mSUGRA parameter regions satisfy radiative electroweak symmetry breaking, a Higgs mass near 125 GeV, no neutralino overproduction and the collider, cosmological and DM-search constraints used by the authors?

sources.title: Exciting Implications of LHC Higgs Boson Data

evidence.text: Do the apparently Standard-Model-like Higgs observations available in 2018 provide clues favoring a supersymmetric two-doublet decoupling theory, TeV-scale superpartners, and a compactified string/M-theory ultraviolet completion?

sources.title: Phenomenology of a little Higgs pseudoaxion

evidence.text: What decay and hadron-collider production signatures can reveal the anomaly-free Simplest Little Higgs pseudo-axion in parameter regions favored by naturalness, after imposing the hidden mass relation and correcting the mass-eigenstate interactions?

sources.title: Stringy Completions of the Standard Model from the Bottom Up

evidence.text: Can the Higgs quartic and electroweak gauge couplings fit a positive-residue closed-string dressing at the high scale required by gauge-boson scattering?

sources.title: Gravitational Positivity Bounds on Higgs-Portal Dark Matter

evidence.text: Under perturbative string UV completion of gravity, how high can a renormalizable Higgs-portal scalar dark-matter model remain valid according to forward-scattering positivity, and what does the resulting heavy-mass regime imply for freeze-in production?

sources.title: Constraining new physics effective interactions via a global fit of electroweak, Drell-Yan, Higgs, top, and flavour observables

evidence.text: How strongly do combined electroweak, Drell–Yan, Higgs, top and flavour measurements constrain dimension-6 SMEFT interactions when SM and hadronic uncertainties, flavour assumptions and renormalization-group evolution are included?

evidence.text: What constraints do combined ATLAS and CMS Run-2 HH searches place on pair production, the trilinear Higgs self-coupling, and the VVHH interaction? HH production probes the scalar potential beyond the information available near its minimum.

sources.title: Axion-like particle at the 10 GeV scale: Higgs decays to wide jets and photons

evidence.text: Can Higgs decays to pairs of approximately 10 GeV ALPs provide observable diphoton-plus-jets or hadronic signals, and accommodate the reported CMS 13.6 GeV diphoton excess while remaining compatible with ATLAS?

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: Solve the leading algebraic vector equation and substitute consistently into the Kähler expansion. This retains the cancellation of an unsuppressed supersymmetric extra D quartic and exposes the remaining higher-dimension terms.

sources.title: Global Fits of the Large Volume String Scenario to WMAP5 and Other Indirect Constraints Using Markov Chain Monte Carlo

evidence.text: The proposed moulding power is half the integrated absolute difference between normalized joint (m0,tan β) posteriors constructed with and without one observable.

sources.title: Randall-Sundrum and Strings

evidence.text: Analyze normalizable radial modes in hard-wall AdS using Bessel functions and an illustrative Dirichlet IR condition. Large operator dimensions give heavier four-dimensional resonances; a semiclassical string falling to the IR wall supplies a complementary redshift argument.

sources.title: Non-thermal CMSSM with a 125 GeV Higgs

evidence.text: A Monte Carlo scan evolves soft terms from the GUT scale, enforces electroweak breaking and Higgs-mass constraints, and calculates spectra and DM observables using SPheno v3.3.3 linked to micrOMEGAS v3.

sources.title: Exciting Implications of LHC Higgs Boson Data

evidence.text: The described Higgs-mass calculation starts with the high-scale soft-breaking Lagrangian and quartic coupling, matches to an effective theory near the geometric mean of stop masses, integrates out heavier scalars, and runs to the top scale. Two-loop threshold corrections and three-loop beta functions are mentioned as available inputs.

sources.title: Phenomenology of a little Higgs pseudoaxion

evidence.text: Electroweak constraints use α_em,G_F,m_Z as inputs, a χ² fit to R_b,R_c,R_e,R_μ,R_τ, and separate two-standard-deviation m_W tests. Corrections include gauge mixing, heavy–light quark mixing and the shifted weak mixing angle.

sources.title: First-order electroweak phase transition in the standard model with a low cutoff

evidence.text: Can a dimension-six Higgs interaction with a low cutoff produce a strong first-order electroweak transition, satisfy precision constraints, and yield experimentally testable Higgs self-couplings?

sources.title: TF08 Snowmass Report: BSM Model Building

evidence.text: Which BSM mechanisms can address electroweak naturalness, strong CP, dark matter, baryogenesis, and flavor, and which theoretical and experimental developments guide their exploration? This is a Snowmass overview of contributed work rather than a single-model investigation.

sources.title: SMEFT effects on the gravitational wave spectrum from an electroweak phase transition

evidence.text: Conditional on a strongly first-order electroweak phase transition driven mainly by the SMEFT φ6 interaction, how precisely could future gravitational-wave observations constrain subleading Higgs wave-function and top-quark loop effects, including when a φ8 term is added?

sources.title: New dimensions at a millimeter to a Fermi and superstrings at a TeV

evidence.text: Can the weak-scale gravity framework with large extra dimensions be embedded in perturbative string theory, and what collider signatures and model-building requirements follow?

sources.title: Conference Summary and Outlook: Particle Physics Past, Present, and Future

evidence.text: What do the Standard Model's historical development and selected ICHEP2018 results imply for outstanding particle-physics questions, future experimental opportunities, and the guiding assumptions of naturalness, minimality and uniqueness?

sources.title: Horizontal gauge symmetry and masses of neutrinos

evidence.text: Can separate scalar sectors suppress horizontal gauge exchange while retaining electroweak symmetry down to a lower scale and ultimately preserving electromagnetism?

sources.title: New Approaches to the Hierarchy Problem and their Signatures from Microscopic to Cosmic Scales

evidence.text: How can microscopic physics generate an electroweak scale v with v/Λ ≪ 1? The dissertation explores neutral naturalness through cosmology and collider signatures, and noncommutative UV/IR mixing as an exploratory alternative.

sources.title: Quantum gravity fluctuations flatten the Planck-scale Higgs potential

evidence.text: Can asymptotically safe gravitational fluctuations predict the scalar potential of a Higgs-portal toy model, possibly making scalar masses irrelevant and enforcing a flat Planck-scale potential? What conditional implications follow for singlet-scalar dark matter?

sources.title: Predictive landscapes and new physics at a TeV

evidence.text: Can a landscape finely scan vacuum energy and Higgs mass parameters while leaving dimensionless couplings nearly fixed, thereby retaining particle-physics predictivity and motivating sparse TeV-scale extensions through environmental selection?

sources.title: Compactified 2HDM under the Non-SUSY AdS instability conjecture

evidence.text: Can a circle-compactified 2HDM accommodate the observed 125 GeV Higgs with radion stabilization and nonnegative vacuum energy, and what conditional heavy-Higgs restrictions follow from applying the non-SUSY AdS instability conjecture?

sources.title: The Hierarchy problem and new dimensions at a millimeter

evidence.text: Can the weak scale be the only fundamental short-distance scale, with the apparent Planck hierarchy arising from large compact spatial dimensions and Standard Model localization, while remaining compatible with laboratory and astrophysical constraints?

sources.title: Gauge hierarchy and metastability from Higgs-driven crunching

evidence.text: Can Higgs-driven cosmological crunching dynamically select a hierarchically small Higgs mass and a metastable electroweak vacuum, and what new physics would make the selected scale phenomenologically relevant?

sources.title: Paper-boat relaxion

evidence.text: Can a Higgs–axion potential instability preferentially select a small electroweak scale while allowing sub-Planckian scanning, an acceptable inflationary duration, and a QCD relaxion compatible with strong-CP relaxation and all cold dark matter?

sources.title: Phenomenological aspects from vacuum stability and metastability in models with soft breaking of a \texorpdfstring{$U\left( 1\right)$}{lg} global symmetry

evidence.text: How do competing neutral electroweak minima constrain a softly broken U(1) two-Higgs-doublet model, its one-loop running, alignment benchmarks and scalar masses compatible with diphoton and electroweak precision fits?

sources.title: Simplest little Higgs model revisited: Hidden mass relation, unitarity, and naturalness

evidence.text: Which quantitative electroweak symmetry breaking predictions and fine-tuning constraints survive in the Simplest Little Higgs model when its scalar potential is renormalized as a continuum EFT, without assuming vanishing UV contributions?

sources.title: The collider landscape: which collider for establishing the SM instability?

evidence.text: Assuming no accessible new physics, which precision measurements and minimal collider specifications could establish SM vacuum instability and determine its scale, potentially providing structural information about a landscape of vacua?

sources.title: Landscape Higgs boson and sparticle mass predictions from a logarithmic soft term distribution

evidence.text: How do landscape Higgs and sparticle mass distributions change when a logarithmic soft-term weight replaces the previously studied power-law weight, subject to anthropic electroweak selection?

sources.title: SUSY without the Little Hierarchy

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetric pseudo-Goldstone Higgs receive a sufficiently large quartic interaction without a corresponding large quadratic term, reducing the little-hierarchy tuning while allowing light stops and satisfying the paper's precision and perturbativity requirements?
